issue.body:
### Description

Error for `amin`, `amax`, and `logsumexp`:
```
XlaRuntimeError: INTERNAL: Failed to execute XLA Runtime executable: run time error: custom call 'xla.gpu.func.launch' failed: Failed to launch CUDA kernel: fusion_4 with block dimensions: 5120x1x1 and grid dimensions: 30733x1x1: CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_VALUE: invalid argument.
```

No errors for `sum`, `mean`, or `prod`.

Minimal reproducing example:
https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1hXANR-lRbHV73SfD5J7FqAwTqLEqsT4P?usp=sharing

The original algorithm uses `sum`/`mean` and runs fine for this size of an array. However, I wanted to see if log-space calculations would result in a lower relative error.

jax v0.4.1 jaxlib v0.4.1

issue.body:
[XLA:GPU] Fix crash in reduction emitter. Use `int64_t` to avoid an overflows.

`CalculateVirtualThreadScalingFactorForReduction` should trigger for small row reductions only. An integer overflow caused it to trigger for very large row reductions and caused runtime crashes.

See https://github.com/google/jax/issues/14013
